function: LootTable.GetRandomItemWithRareBonus(int rareBonusChance) followed by the quantity roll Random.Next(item.MaxQuantity) + 1 (seeded)
description: The item drawn and the quantity rolled, in the order Loot.SpawnLoot does them: the weighted pick (a rare item's weight rises by the rare find bonus, a bonus of zero or less changes nothing), then a quantity from 1 to the item's largest quantity. An empty table throws.
inputs: 14 tables x rare bonus {-10,0,10,20,30,100}. Each row reseeds the generator with 6001 and records 100 draws as "index x quantity", where index is the item's position in the table (see the LootTableItems files). An empty table fails on the first draw and is recorded once.
